$comment: Single source of truth for the table/column rename project.
Every artefact - SQL migration, codemod, leftover guard, post-migration
verification - is generated from THIS file. Never hand-edit a generated
migration and never rename something in code that is not listed here.
'global' -> the column name is unique enough to replace repo-wide.
Only allowed if `check` confirms no other table carries a
column of the same name (or you are renaming it on all of
them). This is the only scope the codemod applies.
'table'  -> the same column name exists on other tables that are NOT
being renamed. Cannot be automated - a repo-wide replace
would corrupt the other tables' call sites. `apply` skips
these and lists every occurrence for manual review.

blocks.note: Delete or ignore - shows the shape only.

tables.note: to: null renames columns only, the table keeps its name.
